title: Fixwell — Free Bootstrap 6 Handyman & Home Services Website Template
excerpt: A free Bootstrap 6 home services template — phone-forward call bar, inline quote card, working postcode coverage checker, pricing and booking.
yoastTitle: Fixwell — Free Bootstrap 6 Handyman & Home Services Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 handyman and home services template with a call bar, inline fixed-price quote card, postcode coverage checker, service pricing, reviews and booking forms.
intro: Fixwell is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 template for handymen, trades and home-services businesses. It is built the way these sites actually convert: a high-contrast call bar with the phone number set large above everything else, and a fixed-price quote card sitting inside the hero rather than a button that scrolls away.
note: The quote card uses a multi-select Combobox for trades, the new Datepicker for preferred dates and a Range slider with a live value bubble to size the job. The coverage section includes a working postcode checker in about twenty lines of vanilla JavaScript.
summary: Fixwell is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 template for handymen, trades and home-services businesses. A phone-forward call bar, an inline fixed-price quote card in the hero built on multi-select Combobox, Datepicker and Range, a working postcode coverage checker, six service cards with pricing, a four-step process, before-and-after work, local reviews and an FAQ. ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step, full light and dark mode.
features: High-contrast call bar with the phone number set large above the header
Fixed-price quote card inside the hero rather than a scroll-away CTA
Multi-select Combobox trade picker, Datepicker and a job-size Range slider with live bubble
Working postcode coverage checker in plain vanilla JavaScript
Six service cards with from-prices, and a four-step numbered process
Before-and-after work grid plus local reviews with star ratings
Trust row: insured, DBS checked and a 12-month guarantee
Accordion FAQ on native <details> — zero JavaScript
Retheme the whole site by changing a single --brand token
Full dark mode via data-bs-theme, remembered across visits
ESM-only vanilla JavaScript — no jQuery, no bundler, no build step
